ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country-rock direction fits my recent listening, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: David Crosby's mellow songwriting appeals to me, though it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Wild Feathers; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar artists today and do not feel drawn to explore this one.
ItemID: NA; Title: Houses of the Holy 2014; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic rock fits my interest in Hendrix, but I am not looking for a reissue right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wings Over America; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The familiar rock songs appeal, but a live album is not what I would choose this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Physical Graffiti; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its bluesy rock fits my taste, but I would pass today in favor of something more relaxed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Live at the Academy of Music 1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Band's roots-oriented sound interests me, but I am not seeking a live recording today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having recently listened to Old Sock, I would choose this for more of Clapton's relaxed blues and roots sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Jackson Browne's songwriting fits my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save this for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am in the mood for songs with vocals and a blues or roots feel rather than mostly instrumental atmosphere.
